rows.note: Use 模型 as the all-purpose noun for a physical replica or a computer/statistical simulation.

example.english: This model was made based on a real bridge.
example.traditional: 呢個模型係照住真橋整㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mou4 jing4 hai6 ziu3 zyu6 zan1 kiu4 zing2 gaa3

rows.note: Use 型號 for the particular make, model, or version of a product, vehicle, or device.

example.english: Check the model number first so you don’t buy the wrong one.
example.traditional: 你睇清楚個型號先，唔好買錯。
example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 cing1 co2 go3 jing4 hou6 sin1 m4 hou2 maai5 co3

rows.note: Use 模特兒 for a person who poses for art or displays products, with the context distinguishing an art model from a fashion or promotional model.

example.english: When that model walked out, the whole venue immediately fell silent.
example.traditional: 嗰個模特兒行出嚟，全場即刻靜晒。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 mou4 dak6 ji4 haang4 ceot1 lei4 cyun4 coeng4 zik1 hak1 zing6 saai3

rows.note: Use 模式 for the structural approach or setup of a business or other complex system.

example.english: This shop’s business model is membership-based.
example.traditional: 呢間舖嘅生意模式係會員制。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 ge3 sang1 ji3 mou4 sik1 hai6 wui2 jyun4 zai3
